verdicts.why: The Lamentis shielding is a deleted scene (LK104DS), and the custody is shown in #5. In the aired #4, Renslayer orders B-15 pruned when found, and the Minutemen knock her out after she frees Loki and Sylvie.
The Paris battle, where Wanda sends the zombified Red Guardian, Yelena and Melina at Kamala, is in Episode 4.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#11
value.text: Doctor Octopus breaks himself and the other villains out of Ryker's Island and forms the Sinister Six to kill Spider-Man.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The hero Otto builds the Sinister Six to kill.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Mastermind of the Sinister Six, built to kill Peter.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#23
split.text: As the Master Planner, Doctor Octopus plots against Spider-Man from a hidden lair. In the Valentine's Day gang war, Spider-Man subdues him, and he is arrested.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The hero who foils Otto's plots and has him arrested.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The Master Planner, whom Peter subdues in the gang war.

verdicts.why: The Sinister Six forms in #11 (Group Therapy). The Master Planner plot runs #14 to #17, and Ock is subdued and arrested in the #23 gang war. So the stage is split and those facts kept at #23 instead of dropped.
Beth meets Frank, sleeps with him and has breakfast with him and Rex in S2#1 (Roadhouse Blues). In #2 Frank is gone and Pilgrim questions her.

value.text: Thanos is Nebula's adoptive father, and she grows to hate him for what he has turned her into. When Ronan vows to kill Thanos, she pledges to help Ronan.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Nebula's adoptive father, whom she hates for what he made her.

verdicts.why: The machinery-for-every-loss detail is first told in Vol. 2. In the first film Nebula says Thanos turned her into this and swears to help Ronan if he kills Thanos. The text now says 'help Ronan' so 'him' cannot be read as Thanos.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
value.text: Disguised as a soldier, Lance Hunter helps S.H.I.E.L.D. kidnap General Glenn Talbot after May and Skye save Talbot from Carl Creel.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
split.text: Talbot, a fan of Hunter's army record, offers him money and a proper burial for Isabelle Hartley to betray Coulson.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Mercenary whom Talbot tries to bribe into betraying Coulson.
split.on_b_card_about_a: General who tries to bribe Hunter into betraying Coulson.

verdicts.why: Hunter, posing as a soldier, helps kidnap Talbot in S2#1 (Shadows), while May and Skye are the ones who save Talbot from Creel. The bribe offer and Hartley's burial come in S2#2, so they go into a split stage.

Harry and Gwen are friends with Peter from #1, and Gwen's worry about Harry's behavior on Globulin Green is season 1 (in #8 she and Peter agree to talk to him). Harry and Gwen start dating in #19 (Growing Pains). So a friend stage at #19 is wrong, and #8 fits.
Ultron frees the Watcher and Peggy and is killed by the Eminence in S3E8 'What If... What If?', which is episode 26 overall (9+9+8).
In S3E9 (Closure), Giyera tortures Simmons on Malick's orders until Fitz agrees to go through the Monolith portal. So the pair do not hold out.
In S3E10 (Maveth), Giyera floats a gun to shoot Daisy as she hacks Hydra's castle systems. Joey melts the bullets and Lincoln knocks Giyera down. The shockwave knockout is #17.
In S3E17 (The Team), Giyera, now loyal to Hive, fights the Secret Warriors at Hydra's base, and Daisy's shockwave knocks him out.

value.text: Director Jeffrey Mace leads the S.H.I.E.L.D. team that storms Eli Morrow's Chinatown Crew headquarters. He is reluctant to use Ghost Rider on the mission and insists that Robbie not be seen by the press.

verdicts.why: In S4E8, Mace is reluctant to use Quake and Ghost Rider and says they cannot be seen by the press. The episode summary has him approve only Quake and Aida, so 'lets him join' is not clearly supported. The 'pay for his crimes' line is from S4E6.
Mace lets Simmons take May to Radcliffe in S4E3 (Uprising). The S4E7 part, where Mace thanks Radcliffe and has him study the boxes, is correct.
On Knowhere, Ronan fights Drax while Nebula chases Gamora. On the Dark Aster, Drax shoots Nebula with the Kyln bazooka.

value.on_a_card_about_b: A scavenger from 2091 who recruits Mike to help save the Lighthouse.

verdicts.why: At S5E12 Deke is not a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent (he becomes one later). He is a former scavenger from 2091, so 'scavenger' alone reads oddly in 2018. 'From 2091' is added.
Secret Invasion never says how long Raava posed as Rhodes, so 'for years' is unsupported. She uses his place in the U.S. government, and Fury kills her.
In 3 AM (S1E1), Wolf orders Madani to drop the Zubair case. His secret work for Rawlins (warning off Ellison, hunting Lieberman) is first shown in Two Dead Men (S1E2).

Mayhem's rampage at the trafficking site, and Tyrone pulling her into the Darkforce while saving a kid guard, are in Shadow Selves (#13). In Vikingtown Sound (#17) she swaps Andre's recording, which gives Tyrone the strength to keep searching for Tandy.
The Judas-bullet shooting ends #7 (Manifest). In #8 Diamondback flips the ambulance and attacks the clinic, where Claire stabs him in the arm when he grabs her through the window.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#11
value.text: Gideon Malick secretly leads HYDRA, and his people kill Coulson's lover Rosalind Price. Coulson calls him and vows to bring down everything he has built, and Malick warns him not to get ahead of himself.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Director who vows to bring Malick down after Hydra kills Rosalind.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Secret Hydra head whose people kill Rosalind. Warns Coulson not to get ahead of himself.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
split.text: Coulson's Secret Warriors capture Malick at Hydra's base, and Coulson interrogates him at the Playground about Rosalind's murder and Hive.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Director who captures and interrogates Malick.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra head Coulson captures and interrogates.

verdicts.why: Rosalind is killed in #8. Coulson's call vowing to bring Malick down, and Malick's 'don't get too far ahead of yourself', are #11 (Bouncing Back). The capture and interrogation are #17 (The Team), so they are kept in a split stage. If another file already adds that #17 stage, use only one.
